text.text: Pillboxes can be quickly knocked out with a precision dive bomber strike or Demolition Charges.
Carrying too much in your backpack will reduce your weapon's accuracy and your movement speed.
Going prone or diving might save your life from the effects of Explosives.
Killing enemies in melee combat rewards additional experience.
The crosshair gives a good estimate of accuracy, but your weapon's muzzle velocity has an additional impact as range increases.
Capturing a base requires a majority of troops, needing 2 out of 3 bars in the capture progress indicator.
Light Machine Guns are best fired when prone or behind cover, and some of them will force you to fire from these stances.
Selling briefcases at the Armory will unlock rare weapons and equipment, but what you get is random!
Rifles are deadly and accurate, but fire slowly. Use caution when fighting in close range against better armed enemies - and bayonets can help!
Sniper Rifles are excellent at taking out the heavily-armoured soldiers from a distance.
Valuables that are dropped by dead soldiers can be looted and sold for RP, or even stored in Stashes to sell later.
In general, the heavier the weapon, the lower your movement speed.
Landing Craft have spawn points, provided that enemies aren't nearby.
The enemy will often utilize emplaced AA Guns on the map - destroy all of them to gain access to air support calls!
The enemy will often utilize emplaced Coastal Guns - destroy all of them gain access to naval artillery calls!
Armories have changed from Running with Rifles - they now visually resemble half-length 'Quonset Huts.'
Be on the lookout for enemy Specialist soldiers - they're tougher and%EOLcome armed with better weapons. Their appearances will be distinct from regular infantry.
When a beach landing gets tough, look for the supporting guns on the Attack Ship - use them to bombard the beach defenses!
There are Armories and Stashes located on the Aircraft Carrier and Attack Ship, be sure to find their locations!
Specialized Assault Troops rush towards their enemy with no regard for cover, firing on the move and trying to get into melee range.
Banzai Chargers are ferocious Assault Troops lead by a Katana-wielding Officer, operating as a squad.
Enemy Flamethrower Operators are resilient against small arms, but are vulnerable to%EOLgrenades, explosives, melee attacks, and even anti-tank rifles.
Binoculars are a great tool for high-ranking soldiers - allowing them to command troops and call in Artillery on more distant locations.
The PT Boat is excellent in providing supporting fire on a beachhead with its vast array of weapons systems.
Destroy any enemy structures to decrease their fighting capacity and gain rewards.
Friendly soldiers and players you accidently kill will not drop their gear.%EOLAnd, if you are accidently teamkilled, you will not lose anything when you respawn!
Eventually, rare weapons and gear on the ground will vanish - but rare weapons will stay on the field far longer.
Not all weapons have a 100% chance to drop when an enemy soldier is killed.
Sentry soldiers are rare specialist troops that spawn with a hip-fired Machine Gun and a thick set of Body Armour.%EOLThey are highly-resistant to small-arms, and to some extent, explosives.
There are various items available in the 'Vest' category, each offering unique advantages.%EOLHowever if you die wearing a vest, you will not respawn with it!
The Veteran 'vest' grants additional resilience to enemy fire, and when you run out of 'luck',%EOLyou still might enter a wounded state from which comrades can revive you.
While most Rocket Launchers perform about the same, some trade velocity for a bigger warhead with extra damage and blast radius.
You can repair vehicles with a wrench by equipping it, standing close to the vehicle, and%EOLholding the 'attack' key until done. And you can carry multiple wrenches!
Stealing Medium and Heavy tanks is not possible in the WW2 DLCs.
Bayonets extend melee range at a slight cost to long-range accuracy, as a result of the extra weight on the front of the gun.
Tanks, halftracks, trucks, and some lighter vehicles can crush most fences in the WW2 DLCs maps.
The valued price of a weapon is often a good estimator as to both its rarity and combat effectiveness.
In missions in which your faction is conducting a massive airlanding operation, you can open the map after dying and spawn behind enemy lines.
Anti-Tank Rifle Grenades have infinite ammo but only provide minimal damage.%EOLThey can be used as a long-term anti-armour solution, but do little up front.
Some handheld Anti-Tank Grenades explode on impact, while others stick to the target and explode after a few seconds.
Radio Jammers, Coastal Guns, and Anti-Air Guns block certain call-ins.%EOLDestroy them for a reward and to be able to call in power support fire!
Certain Missions may prevent calling in Air Support or Paratroopers, such as in the snowy conditions at Bastogne.
Certain enemy assets like Water Towers or docked Submarines offer large XP and RP rewards for destroying them.
Anti-Tank Guns, though only encountered on certain Missions, do what they say on the tin - and excel at it. Be warned!
Sniper Rifles extend your vision sight while standing still, but recover from recoil more slowly.
Carbines offer decent long-range performance for a sidearm weapon, but often don't pack as much short-range damage as Pistols.
Medium MGs usually offer a lot of long-range firepower, but since they can%EOLonly be fired while laying prone or over cover, are better suited for defense.
Weapons with two dots at the bottom of their icon have an alternate mode (see controls.) For many weapons, this toggles the Bayonet.
Sub-Machine Guns are unparalleled in close-quarters fighting and firing on the move, but suffer at long range.
Flamethrowers excel at clearing out strongpoints and well-defended emplacements, including pillboxes, and can even damage most vehicles.
The Banzai and Assault 'vests' grant additional health and a large bonus to movement speed,%EOLbut unlike the Veteran 'vest', you cannot be wounded and revived.
The Sniper 'vest' makes you harder to detect, and slightly harder to hit. These bonuses are of course particularly useful when using a Sniper Rifle.
The Sentry 'vest' is a heavy set of Body Armour. It offers good protection and enables you%EOLto become wounded instead of dying, but impairs movement speed and is markedly expensive.
You can always open the map when you die to select your spawn point.
